pages.title: Firefly Night
pages.creator: Sidrick
pages.description: Firefly Night follows a swarm through a dark forest to light its lanterns. Gather wild fireflies to strengthen the group, steer around thorns and predators and bring enough light to open the moon gate at the end.

pages.title: Rewind House
pages.creator: Thumb Cult Studio
pages.description: Rewind House mixes sorting puzzles with restoring rooms inspired by the 1990s. Move the top items between shelves until each contains four matching objects. Earn stars for the bedroom and kitchen, collecting memory stickers and caring for a pet along the way.

pages.title: ASTRO MARGE
pages.creator: Draxxdglstudio
pages.description: ASTRO MARGE lets you drop planets into a growing stack and merge identical pairs. Aim each release to bring matching planets together, creating larger combinations for points. Plan around the space remaining as the stack continues to rise.

pages.title: Up Hero
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Up Hero sends a hero against waves of monsters with automatic attacks. Move around the battlefield to manage the encounters, level up and choose improvements during the fighting. Build your strength and equipment as the enemy groups become more demanding.

pages.title: Happy Jump
pages.creator: SecGame
pages.description: Happy Jump puts a chicken on a pogo stick for an upward climbing challenge. Charge a jump, aim its path and release toward the next landing. Collect stars and pursue trophies while trying to beat the height of your previous attempt.

pages.title: Celebrity Thanksgiving Prep
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Celebrity Thanksgiving Prep follows celebrities getting ready for a holiday dinner. Create makeup looks, style their hair and choose fall outfits, then join them for cooking activities. Work through the preparations that bring their Thanksgiving celebration together.

pages.title: We Are In A Simulation Simulator
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: We Are In A Simulation Simulator asks you to copy the behavior of other characters. Observe their actions and match movements such as jumping or crouching to blend in. Acting out of sync risks revealing your character as an outsider.

pages.title: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Daily Solitaire Mahjong Classic provides a new tile arrangement to clear each day. Match identical free tiles and plan ahead to expose further pairs. Hints, shuffles, undo and a highlighting torch help you work through the puzzle and maintain a weekly streak.

pages.title: Move the rubber bands: Logic puzzle
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Move the rubber bands: Logic puzzle asks you to arrange elastic bands on matching colored platforms. Move their fasteners between pins and account for the different pin properties, planning a sequence that places every band where it belongs.

pages.title: Barbee Met Gala Transformation
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Barbee Met Gala Transformation lets you style Barbee and her friends for a red-carpet event. Choose clothing and appearance details for each guest, combining bold colors or more traditional glamour into a complete look for the gala.

pages.title: Crocodilo Tralalero Run
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Crocodilo Tralalero Run sends its characters forward automatically through platforming stages. Time jumps to avoid obstacles, deal with enemies and gather coins. Spend the coins in the shop to unlock and customize characters for the next run.

pages.title: Truck Stack Colors
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Truck Stack Colors challenges you to gather platforms that match your truck's color. Build up the stack while advancing through the course, managing its balance as the tower grows. Collecting the right platforms helps you climb higher through the level.

pages.title: JailBreak : Escape from Prison
pages.creator: Geniteam
pages.description: JailBreak : Escape from Prison puts a prisoner through a series of escape challenges. Move with the joystick and use jumps to negotiate the route, completing the level activities as you search for a path beyond the jail bars.

pages.title: Rush Car Driving - Race Master
pages.creator: TearForge Studios
pages.description: Rush Car Driving - Race Master sends you through heavy traffic on urban highways and country roads. Change lanes to find openings between vehicles, then use earned coins to buy another car or improve the one you already drive.

pages.title: Racing Car Destroying Zombie
pages.creator: IronHill
pages.description: Racing Car Destroying Zombie combines hilly driving with fighting through a zombie outbreak. Balance the car over rough ground and smash or shoot the zombies in its way. Earn cash during the run and spend it on stronger vehicle upgrades.

pages.title: Merge Cube Challenge
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Merge Cube Challenge brings 2048-style merging to solo, computer-opponent and two-player modes. Move the numbered cubes into combinations and pursue a higher score, using the bomb power in endless mode to help manage the growing arrangement.

pages.title: Crazy Axe
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Crazy Axe challenges you to aim an axe at enemies and obstacles across action stages. Line up each throw and release it at the right moment, clearing targets while accounting for the dangerous objects and traps in the scene.

pages.title: Unpuzzle Master
pages.creator: Depfov
pages.description: Unpuzzle Master asks you to remove blocks by moving them in their indicated directions. Select a tile whose exit is clear, then use the space it leaves to free other pieces. Work through the bottlenecks until the puzzle is cleared.

pages.title: Festival Vibes Makeup
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Festival Vibes Makeup lets you create three festival-inspired makeup styles for Ellie. Experiment with neon colors, boho patterns and grunge choices, combining eyeshadow, mascara, lipstick and glittery eyebrow details into a finished look for each theme.

pages.title: Cover Dance Party
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Cover Dance Party follows school friends balancing their homework with a holiday dance hobby. Complete their lesson puzzles, then choose looks for the dancers as they prepare a performance. The finished result can be saved as an image.

pages.title: Idle Evolution From Cell to Human
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Idle Evolution From Cell to Human presents creature development as an incremental construction game. Accumulate cells and use them to form successive parts of a creature, working through the stages from a single cell toward complete bodies.

pages.title: Dino Evolution 3d
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Dino Evolution 3d sends your dinosaur into an arena shared with competing creatures. Collect fruit to grow stronger and improve its rank, then use that strength to survive enemy encounters. Work toward being the last dinosaur left in the arena.

pages.title: Dirt Race Lap
pages.creator: GamingStars
pages.description: Dirt Race Lap offers racing championships and lap-time challenges across different tracks. Drive your selected vehicle through the course, pursuing achievements and trying to improve the time recorded for each circuit and vehicle type.

pages.title: Where's the crook?
pages.creator: Aivitu Project
pages.description: Where's the crook? asks you to locate a particular character hidden in a crowded picture. Search the scene for the crook and click the correct person to continue. Each new level gives you another image to examine.

pages.title: Air attack
pages.creator: ivadoGames
pages.description: Air attack sends your aircraft against enemy planes across a sequence of locations. Use machine guns and rockets to defeat the attackers, then improve armor, speed and weapon capacity. Later levels introduce more opponents with better aircraft.

pages.title: Monster Truck Crazy Impossible
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Monster Truck Crazy Impossible puts a customizable truck on stunt courses with large jumps. Drive and adjust its balance to handle the terrain, using nitro when extra speed is needed. Work through the obstacles without losing control of the vehicle.

pages.title: Fruits Mahjong
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Fruits Mahjong asks you to connect matching fruit tiles and clear the board. Look for pairs that can be linked through the open spaces, removing them to expose further choices. Hint and shuffle buttons can help when the layout becomes difficult.

pages.title: Hidden Magic OG
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Hidden Magic OG sends you through rooms in a magical house to help an alchemist. Look around each scene for the objects listed below, selecting the missing items needed for the game's potions and other magical tasks.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Arcade 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Arcade 2 adds two rows of bubbles every fifteen seconds. Shoot toward matching colors to clear space, swapping bubbles when another color is more useful. Larger clears fill a power bar that provides a special booster bubble.

pages.title: Save The Sausage Man
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Save The Sausage Man turns a hanging character's rescue into a series of physics puzzles. Work with the ropes and other props in each scene to release him safely, considering the bombs and hazards before choosing the next action.

pages.title: Ninja Gravity
pages.creator: Smart Play Studios
pages.description: Ninja Gravity follows a ninja climbing a castle tower by jumping between its sides. Tap to switch across the gap, avoiding the obstacles that block the ascent. Collect gold coins along the way to purchase additional character skins.

pages.title: Noob Skyblock
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Noob Skyblock starts you on a small floating island in a two-dimensional block world. Break and collect blocks, craft useful items and build up your home. Expand the island's resources and structures as you work to survive there.

pages.title: Bridge of Doom
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Bridge of Doom asks a dwarf to cross platforms that collapse behind him. Click to advance one space and click rapidly to defeat goblins, then slow down before the traps. Time each move to balance progress with the danger ahead.

pages.title: Hexa loop 3D
pages.creator: Seryas Games
pages.description: Hexa loop 3D asks you to rotate hexagonal pieces into connected patterns. Turn each object until its lines join the neighboring sections, comparing the possible connections across the board. Work through the layouts to finish the looping designs.

pages.title: Tic tac toe
pages.creator: studios m. j. borghi
pages.description: Tic tac toe lets you play against a computer opponent on a small grid. Place circles in empty squares and try to complete a horizontal, vertical or diagonal line of three while blocking the machine's next winning move.

pages.title: Sieger 2 Level Pack
pages.creator: Blaster
pages.description: Sieger 2 Level Pack puts you in command of shots aimed at a castle's supports. Collapse the defenses to eliminate soldiers while protecting peasants, using fewer shots to earn better medals. Treasure chests provide extra score when the structure falls.

pages.title: Your Favorite Royal Couple
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Your Favorite Royal Couple lets you choose a pair of royal characters for Valentine's Day. Style the couple for the occasion, selecting coordinated looks that suit the two characters you want to prepare for their celebration together.

pages.title: I'm a skateman
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: I'm a skateman asks you to draw a route that carries a stickman to the finish. Shape the line around deadly traps and guide it through coins, considering how the character will travel along the path you create.

pages.title: Santa Claus Merge Numbers
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description: Santa Claus Merge Numbers challenges you to combine identical numbers from one through nine. Keep pairing matching values to create the next number, using the space carefully. Reaching nine clears its whole row and opens room for more merges.

pages.title: MathPup Story
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: MathPup Story sends a dog after a bone through platform puzzles. Push and pull boxes into useful positions so MathPup can safely reach the goal, switching between moving the dog and shifting the nearby boxes as the layout requires.

pages.title: Daddy Rabbit
pages.creator: wopa interactive
pages.description: Daddy Rabbit searches an underground burrow for his sleeping babies. Wake them to follow you and keep the family together, using carrots against zombies. Send the little rabbits back to sleep when needed so their cries do not attract danger.

pages.title: Red and Blue Red Forest
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Red and Blue Red Forest sends two characters through a dangerous forest course. Use their movement and double jumps to cross the platforms, collect diamonds and reach the door, coordinating both characters as you work toward the exit.

pages.title: Impossible Track Car Stunt
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Impossible Track Car Stunt puts a racing car onto demanding stunt routes. Steer through mountain-style tracks and manage the vehicle's balance around the course, keeping control as you tackle the driving challenges ahead.

pages.title: Speed Racer
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Speed Racer combines car driving with a collection of unlockable tracks. Complete courses and gather coins along the road, using the earnings to open ten different routes. Control the car's movement and balance as it travels through each level.

pages.title: Pull the Pin Rescue
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Pull the Pin Rescue asks you to free a trapped man by removing pins in the right order. Examine which paths each pin opens and choose a sequence that avoids danger, clearing a safe route through the rescue puzzle.

pages.title: Cook And Decorate
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Cook And Decorate combines serving restaurant customers with improving the kitchen. Tap to cook dishes and deliver them to hungry diners, discarding food when necessary. Use progress from the cooking activity to develop the kitchen's decoration.

pages.title: Adam and Eve Night
pages.creator: Functu
pages.description: Adam and Eve Night strands Adam in a haunted place far from Eve. Explore the scenes and interact with their objects to outwit ghosts and other obstacles, finding the sequence of actions that lets him continue safely toward home.

pages.title: Zig Zag Ball
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Zig Zag Ball asks you to keep a ball on a narrow platform by changing its direction. Tap to turn at the right moment and pass between the crossbars, extending the run for as long as you can without leaving the path.

pages.title: Bubble Planets
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Bubble Planets gives bubble shooting a solar-system appearance. Aim planet-shaped bubbles toward matching groups and fire to remove them, choosing placements that clear more of the board as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Cherry Blossom Cake Cooking
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Cherry Blossom Cake Cooking follows Elsa preparing a cake for Anna at her dessert shop. Help complete the cooking activities for the cherry-blossom design, then continue the sisters' plans for a picnic during the flowering season.

pages.title: Tennis Champions 2020
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Tennis Champions 2020 offers a World Tour, quick matches and practice sets. Use its one-click controls to play shots through each rally, trying to outplay the opponent on court. Choose a mode to start the tennis competition you want to attempt.

pages.title: HellCopter
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: HellCopter puts you in a helicopter descending beside a building occupied by armed enemies. Aim at the attackers on each floor and fire as the aircraft moves past, reloading your weapon to continue the assault down the tower.

pages.title: Picsword Puzzles 2
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Picsword Puzzles 2 shows two pictures that combine to suggest a word. Identify what each image represents and join their meanings into the answer. Solve the picture clues to work through the game's sequence of word puzzles.

pages.title: Find a Pair Animals
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find a Pair Animals gives you animal pictures to match across five levels. Compare the available images and select the matching pair, continuing through the activity until the required animal pairs have all been found.

pages.title: Animals Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Animals Puzzle includes six animal pictures with four piece counts for each. Select 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces and rebuild the image, using the animals' features and background details to connect the sections correctly.

pages.title: School Fun Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: School Fun Differences presents school pictures with five changes to find in each level. Compare the two scenes and select the details that do not match. There is no time limit, so you can examine each image at your own pace.

pages.title: Cartoon Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Cartoon Trucks Jigsaw offers twelve truck-picture puzzles in easy, normal and hard modes. Choose a layout and drag the pieces into their correct places, matching the cartoon vehicle's parts and background until the image is restored.

pages.title: Super Doll Sauna Flirting
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Super Doll Sauna Flirting follows a heroine getting ready for a sauna date. Help her shower, remove jewelry and change into suitable clothing, then continue the couple's visit. Finish by choosing a superhero outfit for her afterward.

pages.title: Basic Math
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Basic Math presents addition, subtraction and greater-than or less-than activities. Compare the numbers and use soccer-ball clues to work out the answer, completing the arithmetic challenges to earn the rewards offered for each cleared stage.

pages.title: Box Puncher
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Box Puncher challenges a fighter to break a stack of boxes before time runs out. Punch from either side and switch positions when a protruding obstacle approaches, keeping the blows going safely to increase your score.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Mahjong Connect asks you to remove matching icon tiles before the timer expires. Select identical pairs that can be connected through the layout, clearing space for more links as you work toward removing the whole board.

pages.title: Mafia Car 3D Time Record Challenge
pages.creator: Smartline-Games
pages.description: Mafia Car 3D Time Record Challenge turns a city drive into a time trial. Guide the car toward the endpoint as quickly as you can, steering through the streets and comparing the finishing time with your previous attempt.

pages.title: Candy Forest
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Candy Forest asks you to arrange candy pieces into matching groups of at least three. Look across the colorful board for possible combinations and make the next match, continuing through the game's candy-themed puzzle activity.

pages.title: BMW M340i xDrive Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: BMW M340i xDrive Puzzle contains six pictures of the car in four jigsaw sizes. Choose a puzzle with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces and arrange the sections to reconstruct the vehicle and its surrounding scene.

pages.title: Monsters Trucks Match 3
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Monsters Trucks Match 3 challenges you to reach a target score within a set number of moves. Arrange three or more matching trucks in a row to remove them, then use the stop button to advance once the requirement is met.

pages.title: Falling Cube
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Falling Cube sends block pieces into a field where complete lines earn points. Move the pieces sideways and rotate them to fit the gaps, clearing several lines together for a larger reward as the level increases.

pages.title: Trials Ride
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Trials Ride puts a trials motorcycle inside a hangar filled with obstacles. Accelerate and adjust the bike's balance to climb over each section, trying to reach the finish in the shortest time while keeping the rider upright.

pages.title: Gun Shot
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Gun Shot makes bottles the targets in a gun-firing challenge. Line up the weapon with the next bottle and release a shot, timing the action so the bullet reaches its mark as you work through the shooting activity.

pages.title: Space Match3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Space Match3 brings a space theme to a tile-matching puzzle. Look for groups of matching pieces and make combinations of three, studying the board for the next useful arrangement as you continue clearing the tiles.

pages.title: Halloween html5
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Halloween html5 presents two Halloween pictures with differences hidden between them. Select the changed details before the timer expires, using the hint button when needed. Finding them more quickly results in a higher score for the puzzle.

pages.title: Draw Physics Line
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Draw Physics Line lets you draw shapes that become physical objects in the scene. Use a line or polygon to push a colored ball toward the matching cup, considering how gravity and collisions will move your drawing after it appears.

pages.title: Drive Park
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Drive Park challenges you to maneuver cars into parking positions. Control the vehicle's approach and line it up with the available space, using careful steering to complete the parking activity before moving on to another attempt.

pages.title: Mermaid Lips Injections
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Mermaid Lips Injections follows a mermaid through a virtual cosmetic appointment. Complete the game's lip-treatment activity using the indicated items, then choose makeup to finish her look. The final styling includes additional color and definition around her lips.

pages.title: Evolution
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Evolution turns growing monsters into a merging puzzle. Select a group of matching creatures and combine them into a stronger form, then use the changing grid to set up another merge. Build larger monsters and work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Swift Cats
pages.creator: Game-Game.com.ua
pages.description: Swift Cats arms a group of cats with a slingshot against a mouse king and his helpers. Aim and launch the cats in turn, choosing trajectories that hit the enemies and bring down the mouse side quickly.

pages.title: Froggy Crosses The Road
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Froggy Crosses The Road follows a frog trying to cross a long, dangerous route. Guide Froggy past the hazards and creatures in the way while gathering coins, choosing moments to move that keep the little frog safe.

pages.title: Happy Baby Bathing Time
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Happy Baby Bathing Time lets you help a mother give her baby a bath. Work through the bathing activities and use the available care items, responding to the game's prompts to keep the little character clean and comfortable.

pages.title: Winter Jigsaw Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Winter Jigsaw Time offers winter pictures to assemble in easy, medium or hard mode. Fit the scattered pieces together by comparing their shapes and image details. There is no timer, so you can work through each scene at your own pace.

pages.title: Funny Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Funny Differences challenges you to compare two playful pictures and find the details that change between them. Search the characters, objects and background, selecting each mismatch until all the required differences have been located.

pages.title: Crashy Traffic
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Crashy Traffic sends you through a pixel-styled road crowded with vehicles. Guide your character's route between the moving cars, collect coins and avoid collisions. Staying clear of traffic lets you continue the run and increase the score.

pages.title: Presidential Golf
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Presidential Golf sends a cartoon president onto a series of golf holes by helicopter. Adjust the swing and power to send the ball toward the hole, planning around bunkers and water hazards as you work through the course.

pages.title: Coloring Underwater World 3
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Coloring Underwater World 3 provides fish and seahorse pictures with two coloring modes. Create your own design in free mode or follow the challenge activity to pursue five stars, choosing colors and filling the underwater scene.

pages.title: Free Kick
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Free Kick gives you three balls for a football scoring challenge. Aim each kick toward the goal and try to make the limited chances count. Progress unlocks additional skins and ball appearances for later attempts.

pages.title: Amazing FreeCell Solitaire
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Amazing FreeCell Solitaire offers classic FreeCell and Baker's Game variations. Arrange the dealt cards through the selected solitaire rules, planning moves between the columns and free spaces to work toward clearing the layout.

pages.title: Food Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Food Hidden Stars hides five stars inside each food picture. Search the image carefully and select every star to open the next level. The untimed search lets you inspect the smaller details without racing a clock.

pages.title: Kitty Quiz
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Kitty Quiz shows a cat and asks you to identify it from three possible answers. Compare the image with the choices and select the correct option, continuing through the different cats presented by the quiz.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire HTML5
pages.creator: CMC Online s.r.o.
pages.description: Spider Solitaire HTML5 lets you choose one-, two- or four-suit card layouts. Build same-suit sequences from king to ace to remove them, placing cards onto values one rank higher. Move properly ordered suited groups together to organize the columns.

pages.title: Miner Block Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Miner Block Game asks you to free a cart loaded with gold from a blocked mine. Slide the rock-filled carts out of its path, planning which moves create enough space for the gold cart to reach the exit.

pages.title: Summer Fashion Cruise Style
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description: Summer Fashion Cruise Style follows Janice preparing for her first day aboard a cruise ship. Browse the clothes and put together a vacation outfit, combining the available fashion choices into a finished look for her time on deck.

pages.title: music simon
pages.creator: Pandemia Games
pages.description: music simon turns the familiar Simon memory challenge into a musical-note activity. Listen to the sequence and repeat the notes in the same order, concentrating on the pattern as you continue through the game's rounds.

pages.title: Farmington
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Farmington puts you in charge of developing a farm through planting and harvesting. Use the available plots to grow crops, gather the harvest and reinvest in the property, managing the fields as your farm expands.

pages.title: Silly Ways To Die Adventure 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Silly Ways To Die Adventure 2 follows its creatures through another set of dangerous levels. React to obstacles and enemies and stop at the right moment when the route demands it, helping the characters survive the next stage of their adventure.

pages.title: Chicken Fettuccine: Sara's Cooking Class
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Chicken Fettuccine: Sara's Cooking Class brings you into Sara's kitchen to prepare the pasta dish. Select the ingredients she requests and follow the cooking steps, working through the recipe until the chicken fettuccine is finished.

pages.title: Ball Vs Boxes
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Ball Vs Boxes challenges you to keep a ball alive among white box obstacles. Time each jump to clear the next box and continue the run, trying to last longer and increase the score with each attempt.
